evidence.rowLabel: Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders
evidence.paragraph: For the three months ended December 31, 2025, Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders was $199.1 million, or $1.09 per diluted share, compared to Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders of $83.1 million, or $0.46 per diluted share, for the same period in 2024.
